subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Releasing bugs into the hole in the northwest corner of the graveyard at night reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Inside the graveyard head for the northwest corner and there you will find a hole in the ground.  Empty one of your bug jars onto the hole and then a GOLD SKULLTULA [034] will pop out for you to defeat.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found on the southeast wall of the graveyard at night and can be killed with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Head over to the southeast side of the graveyard and look up on the wall, there you should see a GOLD SKULLTULA [035] for you to kill with your Boomerang, same deal for grabbing the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping bugs into the hole in front of Dodongo's Cavern on Death Mountain Trail causes a Gold Skulltula to appear.

evidence.quote: Just up the trial a little bit, in front of the Dodongo's Cavern you will come across a hole in the ground.  Use one of your bottles that have bugs in them and put them in the hole to make GOLD SKULLTULA [036] appear.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: In the giant staircase room of Dodongo's Cavern, climbing the vine on the left side leads to a small alcove where a Gold Skulltula crawls on the wall.

evidence.quote: Head down beside the staircase on the left side and there should be a vine you can climb up.  At the top is a small alcove where the GOLD SKULLTULA [037] is crawling around on the wall, use your Boomerang to get it.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At Lon Lon Ranch at night, a Gold Skulltula crawls on the second-floor window to the left and can be defeated using the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: You must enter the Lon Lon Ranch during the night in order to do this....Take a look up on your left at the window on the second floor, you should see a Skulltula crawling around on there.  Aim your Boomerang up at the window and throw it to defeat the enemy and acquire GOLD SKULLTULA [038].

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula crawls along the outer wall around the southwest corner of Lon Lon Ranch at night.

evidence.quote: Next you will want to make your way down to the southwest corner of the ranch.  Run along the outer wall and keep your eye on it, around the southwest corner like I said you will come across the GOLD SKULLTULA [039].

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At Gerudo Valley at night, a Gold Skulltula is found crawling above the waterfall to the right of the entrance bridge.

evidence.quote: Be sure that you enter the valley during the night.  As you cross the bridge at the entrance take a look on your right and crawling above the waterfall here is indeed yet another Skulltula.  You must defeat this enemy using your Boomerang and then use it again to retrieve the GOLD SKULLTULA [040].

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found on the back of the house at Lake Hylia at night.

evidence.quote: When you arrive there you are going to want to make sure it is night time when you enter Lake Hylia....when you step onto the bridge, turn around immediately and take a look on the back of the house, if it's night time then you should see a GOLD SKULLTULA [041] on there.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Emptying a bug jar into the beanstalk hole on the other side of the house at Lake Hylia reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: That's not all either, on the other side of the house you will find another one of those beanstalk holes.  Take one of your bug jars and empty it onto the hole to make a Skulltula pop out.  Defeat the GOLD SKULLTULA [042].

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At Zora's Fountain at night, a Gold Skulltula is found on the wall near the huge log on the right.

evidence.quote: Make a right when you reach Zora's Fountain and climb up onto the huge log....During the night you will see a GOLD SKULLTULA [043] on the wall.

subject: House of Skulltula
text: Collecting forty Gold Skulltulas rewards Link with the Bombchu at the House of Skulltula in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: For acquiring forty Skulltulas you are rewarded with the BOMBCHU.

subject: Keaton Mask
text: Selling the Keaton Mask to the soldier guarding the northern exit in Kakariko Village yields 15 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Set the mask to one of your C Buttons and then equip it, after doing that speak with the soldier guarding the north exit and he will pay you 15 Rupees for the mask

subject: Deku Scrub
text: Wearing the Skull Mask in the underground grotto of the Lost Woods allows Link to receive the Deku Stick upgrade from the Deku Scrub on the right.

evidence.quote: At the bottom take a few steps forward so that you are overlooking all the Deku Scrubs under the ground and equip the Skull Mask.  They will quickly pop out of the ground and start running around.  Speak with the Deku Scrub on your right in order to get the next DEKU STICK UPGRADE.

subject: Skull Mask
text: Wearing the Skull Mask on the small stump in the Lost Woods allows Link to sell it to the Skull Kid for ten Rupees.

evidence.quote: Now head back to the entrance of The Lost Woods and make a left turn.  Here you will find the Skull Kid up on the pillar.  Jump onto the small stump here and press the A button while wearing the mask, Skull Kid will give you ten Rupees for it.

subject: Spooky Mask
text: Wearing the Spooky Mask and speaking to the kid walking around the Graveyard sells the mask for full price.

evidence.quote: Head for the Graveyard and you will find some kind walking around here, equip the Spooky Mask and speak to him, he'll buy the mask for full price.

subject: Bunny Hood
text: Selling the Bunny Hood to the man running laps around Lon Lon Ranch completely fills Link's wallet with Rupees.

evidence.quote: Take the BUNNY HOOD from the shop and leave town.  Head southwest from Hyrule Town to Lon Lon Ranch, there is a man running laps around the ranch.  Once you find this man speak to him while wearing the Bunny Hood and he will pay you for it.  Basically what he does is just give you money until your wallet is full

subject: Happy Mask Shop
text: Completing the mask trading sidequest allows Link to borrow the Mask of Truth to listen to Gossip Stones.

evidence.quote: There is also a special bonus, you are now free to borrow the MASK OF TRUTH whenever you want to.  The Mask of Truth allows you to listen to all those Gossip Stones placed conveniently around the world

subject: Song of Time
text: The Song of Time is played on the Ocarina using the button combination right, A, down, right, A, down.

evidence.quote: Play the Song of Time which you just learned (right, A, down, right, A, down).

subject: Adult Link
text: Link officially transforms into Adult Link after obtaining the Master Sword in the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: SWORD.  You have now officially transformed into Adult Link, a world awaits.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch
text: Ingo allows Link to ride a horse at Lon Lon Ranch for ten Rupees with a one minute timer.

evidence.quote: Speak to Ingo and he will offer to let you ride one of his horses for a mere ten Rupees, you should agree to this.  A one minute timer will appear.

subject: Epona's Song
text: Playing Epona's Song with the notes up, left, right, up, left, right causes Epona to run toward Link.

evidence.quote: Bring up your Ocarina and play Epona's Song (up, left, right, up, left, right) and when you do this Epona the horse will automatically run toward you.

subject: Lon Lon Ranch
text: Challenging Ingo to a horse race around the fenced area requires a bet of 50 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Speak to Ingo and he will ask if you want to bet 50 Rupees on a race, you certainly do.  When the race begins you will have to do one lap around the fenced area against Ingo.

subject: Epona
text: Using carrots to run toward either outer wall allows Epona to jump the fence and escape Lon Lon Ranch onto Hyrule Field.

evidence.quote: use a couple of carrots and run toward either outer wall and Epona will jump the fence and jump out of Lon Lon Ranch entirely.  With Epona on the field you can now get from place to place much easier than you could before
